rule_outs: Dwelling 7 m from the best section
summary: Very steep street lined with homes 7-11 m away; no stopping signs.

drivers.seclusion: Houses and garages sit 4-11 m from the kerb along the whole length; dense bush only at the top end.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, but the climb runs 13-19% everywhere, above the 12% limit.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, dead-end bush at the top.
drivers.convention: A few cars parked on the street; two No Stopping Any Time signs near the top.

sun_shade: Mixed tree shade; open sky along the sealed street, bush shade at the top.
